question: Will Bitcoin (BTC) reach or exceed $82,000 at any point on August 26, 2026 (UTC)?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the BTC/USDT spot price on Binance reaches or exceeds $82,000 at any point on August 26, 2026 (UTC).
- "No": Wins if the BTC/USDT spot price on Binance does not reach $82,000 at any point on August 26, 2026 (UTC).

Clarifications:
- "Reaches" means the BTC/USDT last traded price on Binance is recorded at or above $82,000.00 at any moment during the 24-hour window of August 26, 2026 (00:00:00–23:59:59 UTC).
